column1: # Benchmark baseline (PF-01): median and fastest seconds per benchmark and engine on the reference host,
# written by scripts/benchmark.py --update-baseline. Regressions are judged on the fastest run, normalized by
# this host's speed relative to the reference host (the geometric mean of the native times); see the script.
# minopts: the translated methods the JIT compiled with MinOpts; a JIT engine fails when a benchmark has more.
# Host: AMD RYZEN AI MAX+ 395 w/ Radeon 8060S, 32 cores; .NET runtime 10.0.14; Debian clang version 22.1.8 (1+b2)
# Commit: the JP-02 commit's tree (113adb3 with JP-02 to JP-05 and JP-09); written 2026-11-05 11:06 UTC
# tramp3d jit minopts: 1 since JP-05's use-site values (two advect instantiations came under the thresholds)
